text: Caught up with Eilidh after work. Her dad passed away last Tuesday and the funeral is Thursday at 11 in Inverness. She's holding up but sounds exhausted. Her brother Sam is flying back from Toronto the day before. Need to send flowers to the house that morning.

Long call with Kemal. He's been made redundant, last day is the 31st. Says he's fine but he clearly isn't. His wife Lena is due in January so the timing's awful. Remind me to check in with him next week.

Pooja's daughter Ruby has her grade 5 piano recital Saturday at 2pm at the music school. Ruby's really nervous about it, keeps fluffing the middle section. Pooja says she practises every night after dinner.
Abdi and his partner are expecting! Twelve week scan was yesterday morning. Due in May. They're not telling his parents till Sunday lunch so keep it quiet.
Gustavo is running the Cardiff half on the 5th. Starts at 9am. His knee's been playing up since the summer. Text him good luck the night before.

Coffee with Aaliyah. She and Owen have split up, after six years. She's staying at her sister's for now. Owen's keeping the flat. She seemed more relieved than sad honestly. Should take her out for dinner sometime next week.
Niamh's baby arrived Monday at 4am! A little girl, Orla, 7lb 2. Both doing well. Christening pencilled in for March. Don't forget to get a card and something small for the baby.

spans.text: get a card and something small for the baby

text: Ahmed's band have a gig at the Brudenell on Friday at 8. I'm going with Hemi. Afterwards we're getting food at the Thai place.
Spoke to Matilda. Her nan's funeral was Wednesday. She said the service was lovely and her mum read a poem. Matilda's going back to work Monday but isn't sure she's ready. Must ring her that weekend.
Nadia's mum is having her hip operation on the 14th at 8am. Nadia's taking the week off to look after her. She's stressed about juggling the kids as well.
Jakub mentioned his football team made the cup final, it's Sunday at 10:30 at the rec. His son Theo is mascot. They're all buzzing.
Rafael and Catalina's christening for little Mateo has been called off, the priest is ill. They'll rebook for spring. Catalina sounded gutted.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 10.

Tomás got made redundant on Friday, totally out of the blue. Twenty years at the same firm. He's got a meeting with HR on Wednesday at 3 to sort the package. His wife Afua's being amazing apparently, already updating his CV for him. Their son starts uni in September so money's a worry. Remind me to ask Tomás how the HR meeting went.

spans.text: Twenty years at the same firm
ask Tomás how the HR meeting went

text: Lwazi's mum died over the weekend. Funeral is next Friday in Durban, he flies out Tuesday night. He's not great. His girlfriend Kasia is going with him and they're staying with his aunt. His younger brother couldn't get time off work, which has caused some friction. Lwazi's mum was a nurse for forty years, the whole town knew her. Need to message him before he goes.
Rahul says Tamar is pregnant again, due around Easter. Their eldest, Zara, is thrilled about being a big sister. Tamar's had terrible morning sickness this time though.

Rana's play opens on the 12th at half 7 at the Library Theatre. She plays the mother. First proper lead role, she's petrified. Her partner Hamza is doing the lighting, so they've basically been living at the theatre. Closing night is the 19th with a party afterwards. Book tickets for the Saturday show.

spans.text: Book tickets for the Saturday show

text: Hamza and his wife lost their dog Biscuit last week, the vet said it was his heart. The kids are heartbroken. Hamza's taking them to the beach Saturday to cheer them up.
Vikram's got his driving test Thursday at 9:40. Third attempt. His mum's more nervous than he is.
Fang mentioned her cousin's wedding got cancelled, the groom backed out two weeks before. She's furious on her cousin's behalf.
Eilidh's brother Sam ran the Loch Ness marathon on Sunday, finished in 3:41. She was at the finish line with their mum. Should text Sam congrats.

Kemal had his redundancy consultation this morning. They're offering voluntary terms, he's got till Friday at 5 to decide. He's leaning towards taking it and going freelance. His boss was apparently decent about it. Ring him Thursday evening to talk it through.

Chat with Lena. Baby's due on the 28th but she's had high blood pressure so they might induce the week before. Kemal's mum is coming to stay a week after the birth. Lena loves anything lemon, a lemon drizzle would go down well.

spans.text: lemon drizzle would go down well

text: Abdi's twins are being christened on the 9th at 11am at St Mary's, with a lunch at his in-laws afterwards. I'm godmother to one of them which I didn't expect! Need to buy something silver the day before.

Gustavo's half marathon update: he did it in 1:52, knee held up. Celebrating at the pub that evening with his running club. Next he wants to do Berlin in September, ballot opens in a fortnight. His wife thinks he's mad.

Owen called. He's taking the breakup harder than Aaliyah is, I think. Moved back in with his parents for a bit. He's thinking of going travelling in the new year. Must invite him round for dinner, maybe Sunday.

Pooja told me her husband Vik got made redundant last month. They're managing on her salary but it's tight. He has an interview on Monday at 2 with a logistics firm. Ruby's recital went brilliantly in the end apparently, got a distinction. Pooja is trying to keep things normal for her. Remind me to ask Pooja on Tuesday how Vik's interview went.

spans.text: ask Pooja on Tuesday how Vik's interview went

text: Note to self: Niamh's baby Orla, christening is now confirmed for 15 March, 12 noon. Niamh asked me to be godparent. Afterwards there's food at the Crown.

Hemi's daughter is in the regional swimming championships next weekend. Heats Saturday morning, finals Sunday afternoon if she gets through. Hemi's driving up Friday night and staying over. She's been training at 6am every day for months, poor kid hasn't had a lie in since July. Hemi's wife can't go because of work. Remind me to ask how she got on.
Saw Matilda at the shops. She's doing a bit better. Her mum's selling her nan's house in the spring. Matilda wants to keep the piano but has no room for it.
Nadia's mum's op went fine, home after two days. Nadia's shattered. Ought to drop a meal round on Saturday.
Jakub's team lost the final on penalties. Theo cried apparently, but loved being mascot. Jakub's already talking about next season.

Long one with Catalina. She's pregnant again, only eight weeks so hush hush. Rafael doesn't want a big christening this time, just family. Mateo's christening is rebooked for 20 April at 1pm. Her mum is flying in from Bogotá the week before and staying a month. Catalina is a bit anxious about the scan on the 3rd, the last one had complications. I should send her something the day of the scan to say I'm thinking of her.

Tomás and his partner Afua broke up. Wait, no, that's wrong, it's Tomás's brother Santiago who broke up with his girlfriend. Santiago's moved into Tomás's spare room. Tomás says it's like being students again.
Lwazi back from South Africa. Said the funeral was huge, half the village came. He's taking a few weeks to sort his mum's affairs. Kasia's been his rock. Check in with him next week.
Choir concert tonight, I'm in the altos. Call time 6:30.
Rahul's band are doing a reunion gig at the Jazz Café on the 22nd, doors at 7. Tamar won't make it, she's too far along. He's put me and Fang on the guest list. Remember to bring earplugs.

spans.text: reunion gig at the Jazz Café

text: Rana said opening night went well but she forgot a line in act two. Reviews come out Thursday. Her dad came down from Glasgow for it. Ask her what the reviews said.

spans.text: Ask her what the reviews said

text: Hamza's wife Nadia, not my Nadia, his one, had their baby boy on Sunday night! Named him Yusuf. They're all home now. Need to send congrats and sort a gift with the others.

spans.text: sort a gift with the others

text: Vikram passed his driving test!! First time round with no minors he said. Already looking at cars. His sister Pooja is going to lend him hers till he gets one.
Fang's grandad passed away on Monday. He was 94. She's flying to Shanghai on Thursday for the funeral, back the following week. She's okay, said he had a good long life.
Kemal update: took the redundancy. Last day is the 30th, leaving drinks that evening at the Fox. Lena's due a fortnight later. Big month for them.
Book dentist and renew car insurance before the 1st.

Had lunch with Eilidh and Niamh. Eilidh's thinking of moving back up to Scotland to be near her mum now her dad's gone. Niamh is on maternity leave till September and loving it. Orla has her first jabs on Wednesday morning.
Aaliyah got the job in Manchester! Starts 1st of December. Her ex Owen doesn't know yet. She's flat hunting the weekend before. Remind me to send her a list of decent areas.

spans.text: send her a list of decent areas

text: Abdi's dad is in hospital, had a fall on Saturday. They think it's a broken hip, surgery is tomorrow afternoon. Abdi is with him at the RVI. Text Abdi tomorrow evening.
Ruby's got a place in the county youth orchestra! Pooja's beaming. First rehearsal is Saturday at 10.

spans.text: place in the county youth orchestra

text: Matilda's sister Kasia is expecting her first in June. Matilda's going to be an aunt and is already knitting. Kasia's husband is a midwife, which is handy.

Gustavo said his mum's been diagnosed with early dementia. They're having a family meeting at the weekend to plan care. He's really struggling with it. I should call him Sunday night after the meeting.
Nadia Baker from work, her husband got made redundant from the factory. She's worried about the mortgage. She'd appreciate anyone knowing jobs going in engineering.

spans.text: appreciate anyone knowing jobs going in engineering

text: Jakub and his partner are doing the Great North Run next September for the hospice that looked after his gran. Training starts in January. Must sponsor them.
Quick one: Hemi's daughter won silver at the regionals! Off to nationals in Sheffield in February.
Rafael's football match got rained off Saturday, rescheduled for Wednesday at 7:30 under the lights.
Tamar had the baby, Thursday at 6:15am, a boy called Eli. Rahul is on cloud nine. Visiting is fine from the weekend. Get a babygro, they like the stripy ones from that shop in town.

spans.text: like the stripy ones from that shop in town

text: Santiago's gig with his new band is on the 18th at 9pm in the back room of the Oak. He's nervous, first time singing lead. I said I'd bring Tomás and Afua. Text him good luck that afternoon.
Owen mentioned his granddad's funeral is the 7th at 10am, crematorium then the club afterwards. He was close to him. Remind me to send a card the day before.

Lena and Kemal's baby came early, Saturday at half 9 at night! Baby Defne, 6lb. Kemal's last day got moved so he's home anyway. Lena's mum arrives the day after tomorrow. Must drop round lemon drizzle when they're ready for visitors.
Vikram's cousin Rahul... no, that's a different Rahul. Vikram's cousin is getting married in Delhi in December, three days of it. Vikram's dreading the dancing.

Kasia Nakamura said her uncle's restaurant closed down after thirty years, all the staff laid off including her brother Theo. Theo's applying for chef jobs and has a trial shift at a hotel on Monday at 4. Their uncle is devastated, it was his whole life. She's taking him for a drink Friday after work to cheer him up. Ask Kasia how Theo's getting on in a couple of weeks.

spans.text: Ask Kasia how Theo's getting on

text: Afua's netball team is in the league final on Sunday at 3. Her husband Ahmed and the kids are going to watch. I said I'd come too. Bring a flask, it's freezing there.
